title: Nabhold TradeLane domain identifiers, enumerations and resource
description: Gate ZB-01 initial publication (ADR-SHARED-008 SS5): a governed origin/destination market relationship a tenant may trade along (ADR-BCP-011's cross-market trading model). Governed under the capability/v1 namespace registry's `market` domain.

tradeLaneId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a TradeLane.

tradeLaneDirection.description: Direction of goods flow along a TradeLane, per ADR-BCP-011's per-market participation flags.

permitted_capability_keys.description: Capability keys this tenant may exercise along this lane (e.g. procurement.*, logistics.*).
